category: free one-click file host, retrieval target

free_tier.stated: 2 GB per file ('A file can not be larger than 2 gigabyte.'), no account needed ('without registration'), no limit on the number of files, and files are removed after 30 days without a call unless a retention period is set. The FAQ answers 'Yes, absolutely free!'; the terms also refer to paid offers for registered users ('With registration and paid offers, users have more options').

retention.stated: files expire 30 days after the last download (vendor default), extendable at upload time

egress.terms: No cap published and no paid path to remove one. Users report 200-350 KB/s in practice.

interface_detail: Browser upload and download only; no API.
chaining: A free host: it composes as the source of a one-off file rather than as part of a retrieval stack. The terms mention paid offers for registered users, but none is priced on the pages read.

limits.value: users report 200-350 KB/s; no vendor number

limits_note: The FAQ answers 'Yes, absolutely free!' and the About page lists the premium features as free for all; the terms mention paid offers for registered users, but no price page was found.

identity_cost.detail: No account is needed to upload or download; a free account only raises storage.

reliability_note: Downloads of a 2 GB file take about two and a half hours at the observed rate; some users report transfers stalling every 10-20 MB.
confidence_note: The vendor page confirms the free-only shape and the 2 GB cap; the rate is a forum report, not a measurement.
